# Illustrated workspace and quick repository optimization prompts

## Summary
- Add cohesive generated 3D imagery across all Station views, agent/prompt cards, previews, and shared workflows.
- Add restrained interactive perspective effects, floating annotations, motion controls, and reduced-motion support.
- Add six quick repo prompts with safety and verification guardrails, library filtering, copying, customization, and automatic Coding mode.
- Preserve existing PostgreSQL/Drizzle persistence and Shelley execution integration.
- Restore bundled typography and update framework dependencies.

## Validation
- Next.js route type generation
- TypeScript no-emit check
- Production build and runtime/database health check
- Browser smoke checks for page artwork, quick-prompt flow, persistence, sharing, filters, mobile overflow, motion preferences, and console errors

## Notes
Category artwork is reused across related catalog items. The generation tool provided no model selector; assets are not represented as GPT image 2.5 output. Live execution requires the existing Shelley server configuration. See `ILLUSTRATED_STATION.md` for setup, artwork regeneration, and verification details.
